Q6097.reason: Most states abolish the fee tail and convert it to fee simple, so the cousin already holds the whole fee and the later conveyance to the niece passes nothing.

Q5137.reason: The doctor would be testifying to what the x-ray films show, and under the best evidence rule the films themselves must be produced.

Q5526.reason: Breaking into a hotel room and entering it with intent to commit a crime (threatening or extorting the guest) fits burglary, whereas in B a thrown brick is arguably not an entry.
